# Read data

```{r}
# data file
data <- read.csv("Data/PDRI_curated_full.csv", header = T, check.names=FALSE, na.strings=c("",".","NA", "N/A"))

# variable sheet for data manipulation and selection
variables <- read.csv("Worksheets/PDRI_variables.csv", header = T, check.names=FALSE, na.strings=c("","NA","N/A"))
```

# PREDIGT score

```{r}
FG  <- TRUE # including factor G?
FT  <- TRUE # including factor T?

# PPV and NPV
prevalence <- 1/100 # prevalence
plotPPV <- TRUE

# compare AUC in Female vs Male
sex_ind <- 0 # 0: Both; 1: Female; 2: Male
```


```{r}
scrCalc <- function(data, varStr2, coefV, vFH, newVar, print = FALSE,
                    varStr_motor = NULL, coefV_motor = c(0.25, 1, 1)) {
  
  if (print) {
    for (i in 1:length(varStr2)) {
      print(table(data %>% select(all_of(varStr2[i])), useNA = "ifany"))
    }
  }
  # w/o motor
  varStr1 <- c(c("ID", "group", "sex","age"), varStr2)
  
  ind_question <- NULL # Only in self-report
  ind_D <- which(varStr2 == vFH)
  ind_E <- c(1:(ind_D-1))
  ind_I <- c((ind_D+1):length(varStr2))
  
  data$new <- PREDIGTScr(data, varStr1, varStr2, coefV, ind_question, unique(data$EVENT_ID), FG, FT, ind_E, 
                         ind_D, ind_I, method = 1)$data$score
  names(data)[which(names(data) == "new")] <- newVar
  
  # with motor
  if (!is.null(varStr_motor)){
    if (print) {
      for (i in 1:length(varStr_motor)) {
        print(table(data %>% select(all_of(varStr_motor[i])), useNA = "ifany"))
      }
    }
    varStr2 <- c(varStr2, varStr_motor)
    coefV <- c(coefV, coefV_motor)
    
    varStr1 <- c(c("ID", "group", "sex","age"), varStr2)
    
    ind_question <- NULL # Only in self-report
    ind_D <- which(varStr2 == vFH)
    ind_E <- c(1:(ind_D-1))
    ind_I <- c((ind_D+1):length(varStr2))
    
    data$new <- PREDIGTScr(data, varStr1, varStr2, coefV, ind_question, unique(data$EVENT_ID), FG, FT, ind_E, 
                           ind_D, ind_I, method = 1)$data$score
    names(data)[which(names(data) == "new")] <- paste0(newVar, "_motor")
  }
  
  return(data)
}
```

## Original

```{r}
varStr2 <- variables$Short.name[which(variables$Original == 1)]

# Coeffcients
coefV <- c(0.5,     # 1:  Metal
           0.25,    # 2:  Pesiticide
           0.25,    # 3:  Farm
           0.5,     # 4:  head trauma
           0.5,     # 5:  constipation
           0.5,     # 6:  olfaction
           -0.0625, # 7:  smoking: any<10y*1, Ex11-19*2, Ex20*4, Current11-19*8, Current20*12
           -0.125,  # 8:  caffeine: >=1*1, >=2*2
           0.125,   # 9:  family history: 3rd*1, 2nd*2, 1st*4
           0.25,    # 10: depression
           0.25,    # 11: anxiety
           0.25     # 12: RBD
)

data <- scrCalc(data, varStr2, coefV, vFH = "family_history_dir", newVar = "PREDIGT_O", TRUE,
                NULL)

# Estimated score range, see notes in Table 3
df_range <- data[1:2,] %>% select(-PREDIGT_O)
# min: 40 yrs female who responded negative to all the risk factors
df_range[1, which(names(data) %in% varStr2)] <- c(0,     # 1:  Metal
                                                  0,    # 2:  Pesiticide
                                                  0,    # 3:  Farm
                                                  0,     # 4:  head trauma
                                                  0,     # 5:  constipation
                                                  0,     # 6:  olfaction
                                                  12, # 7:  smoking: any<10y*1, Ex11-19*2, Ex20*4, Current11-19*8, Current20*12
                                                  2,  # 8:  caffeine: >=1*1, >=2*2
                                                  0,   # 9:  family history: 3rd*1, 2nd*2, 1st*4
                                                  0,    # 10: depression
                                                  0,    # 11: anxiety
                                                  0)     # 12: RBD
df_range[1, "sex"] <- "Female"
df_range[1, "age"] <- 40

# max: 100 yrs male who responded positive to all the risk factors

                                                  1,    # 3:  Farm
                                                  2,     # 4:  head trauma
                                                  1,     # 5:  constipation
                                                  1,     # 6:  olfaction
                                                  0, # 7:  smoking: any<10y*1, Ex11-19*2, Ex20*4, Current11-19*8, Current20*12
                                                  0,  # 8:  caffeine: >=1*1, >=2*2
                                                  4,   # 9:  family history: 3rd*1, 2nd*2, 1st*4
                                                  1,    # 10: depression
                                                  1,    # 11: anxiety
                                                  1)     # 12: RBD
df_range[2, "sex"] <- "Male"
df_range[2, "age"] <- 100
df_range <- scrCalc(df_range, varStr2, coefV, vFH = "family_history_dir", newVar = "PREDIGT_O", FALSE,
                NULL)
df_range$PREDIGT_O
```

# Smell tests

```{r}
# Answer keys
smell_key <- read.csv("Worksheets/Olfactory_UPSIT_neuroscent_key.csv", header = T, check.names=FALSE, na.strings=c("","NA","N/A"))
```

## UPSIT

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

UPSIT <- data %>% select(ID, UPSIT.01.M:UPSIT.40.M)

# Transform multiple choice responses into dichotomous (0 = incorrect; 1 = correct)
for (i in 1: 40) {
  UPSIT$new <- ifelse(UPSIT[,i+1] != smell_key$UPSIT[i], 0, 1)
    
  if (i < 10) {
    str <- paste0("UPSIT.0", i, ".B")
  } else {
    str <- paste0("UPSIT.", i, ".B")
  }
  names(UPSIT)[names(UPSIT) == "new"] <- str
}

# Calculate UPSIT score
UPSIT$UPSIT_scr <- rowSums(UPSIT %>% select(UPSIT.01.B:UPSIT.40.B))

# UPSIT percentile
upsit_norm <- read.csv("Worksheets/UPSIT norm.csv", header = T, na.strings=c("",".","NA", "N/A"))
upsit_norm[is.na(upsit_norm)] <- 4
upsit_norm_long <- upsit_norm %>% pivot_longer(-c(UPSIT, sex), names_to = "age_cat", values_to = "UPSIT_percentile")
upsit_norm_long$age_cat <- factor(upsit_norm_long$age_cat, levels = c("X35.39", "X40.44", "X45.49", "X50.54", "X55.59", "X60.64", "X65.69", "X70.74", "X75.79", "X80.84", "over85"))
levels(upsit_norm_long$age_cat) <- c("35-39", "40-44", "45-49", "50-54", "55-59", "60-64", "65-69", "70-74", "75-79", "80-84", "over85")
upsit_norm_long$ref <- paste(upsit_norm_long$sex, upsit_norm_long$age_cat, upsit_norm_long$UPSIT, sep = "_")

upsit_percentile <- UPSIT %>% select(ID, UPSIT_scr) %>% left_join(data %>% select(ID, sex, age), by = "ID")
upsit_percentile <- upsit_percentile %>% mutate(age_cat = ifelse(is.na(age), NA, case_when(
  age < 40 ~ "35-39",
  age < 45 ~ "40-44",
  age < 50 ~ "45-49",
  age < 55 ~ "50-54",
  age < 60 ~ "55-59",
  age < 65 ~ "60-64",
  age < 70 ~ "65-69",
  age < 75 ~ "70-74",
  age < 80 ~ "75-79",
  age < 85 ~ "80-84",
  TRUE ~ "over85"
)))
upsit_percentile$ref <- paste(upsit_percentile$sex, upsit_percentile$age_cat, upsit_percentile$UPSIT_scr, sep = "_")

upsit_percentile <- upsit_percentile %>% left_join(upsit_norm_long %>% select(ref, UPSIT_percentile), by = "ref")

UPSIT <- UPSIT %>% left_join(upsit_percentile %>% select(ID, UPSIT_percentile, age_cat), by = "ID")
UPSIT <- UPSIT %>% 
  mutate(olfaction =ifelse(is.na(UPSIT_percentile), NA,
                           ifelse(UPSIT_percentile <= 15, "Reduced", "Normal"))) # DOI: 10.1002/mds.24892

# Save results
data <- data %>% left_join(UPSIT %>% select(ID, UPSIT_scr, UPSIT_percentile, age_cat, olfaction), by = "ID")
```

# NeuroScent

```{r}
neuroscent <- data %>% select(ID, neuroscent1.M:neuroscent8.M)

# Transform multiple choice responses into dichotomous (0 = incorrect; 1 = correct)
for (i in 1: 8) {
  neuroscent$new <- ifelse(neuroscent[,i+1] != smell_key$NeuroScent[i], 0, 1)
  names(neuroscent)[names(neuroscent) == "new"] <- paste0("neuroscent.", i, ".B")
}

# Calculate neuroscent score
neuroscent$neuroscent_scr <- rowSums(neuroscent %>% select(neuroscent.1.B:neuroscent.8.B))

# Save results
data <- data %>% left_join(neuroscent %>% select(ID, neuroscent_scr), by = "ID")
```

# 2-step combined

```{r}
df_dev <- data %>% filter(group %in% c("HC", "PD")) %>% droplevels() %>% 
  mutate(group_num = ifelse(group == "HC", 0, 1))

df_res <- data.frame()

# PREDIGT_O + UPSIT_scr
fit1 <- glm(group_num ~ PREDIGT_O + UPSIT_scr, data = df_dev, family = binomial())
summary(fit1)
data$PREDIGT_O_UPSIT <- predict(fit1, newdata = data, type="response") * 100 # using probability
df_res <- bind_rows(df_res,
                    data.frame(name = "PREDIGT_O + UPSIT_scr",
                               intercept = coef(fit1)[1],
                               questionnaire = coef(fit1)[2],
                               smell_test = coef(fit1)[3]))

# PREDIGT_S_B_motor + neuroscent_scr
fit1 <- glm(group_num ~ PREDIGT_S_B_motor + neuroscent_scr, data = df_dev, family = binomial())
summary(fit1)
data$PREDIGT_S_B_motor_neuroscent <- predict(fit1, newdata = data, type="response") * 100 # using probability
df_res <- bind_rows(df_res,
                    data.frame(name = "PREDIGT_S_B_motor + neuroscent_scr",
                               intercept = coef(fit1)[1],
                               questionnaire = coef(fit1)[2],
                               smell_test = coef(fit1)[3]))

```

```{r}
write.csv(df_res, "Data/Code generated/Two_step_combine_betas.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(data, "Data/Code generated/PDRI_curated_scores.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
